Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry) workflow using DDA. Quantification is performed via SAINTexpress to filter interactors against IgG controls, which is typical for label-free AP-MS. No specific PTM enrichment (like phospho or ubiquitylome) was performed; the variable modifications listed are standard search parameters.

organism: Database searches were performed with Mascot (Matrix Science, Inc., Boston, MA, USA) against the human Uniprot database
cell_lines: PC-3 and SKOV-3 cell lines that represent models for prostate and ovarian cancer
PC-3, DU-145 (human prostate cancer) and SKOV-3 (human ovarian cancer) cell lines
scope: Affinity purification coupled to mass spectrometry confirmed that the HMGB1 nuclear interactome
approach based on immunoprecipitation (IP) and mass spectrometry (MS) in PC-3 and SKOV-3 cell lines
Whole cell lysates were incubated with anti-HMGB1 antibody (ab86070, Abcam) coupled to Protein G Dynabeads
On-bead digestion was carried out as previously described

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis focused on the HMGB1 interactome using affinity purification (immunoprecipitation) from both whole cell lysates and subcellular fractions (nuclear/cytoplasmic). Per the precedence rules, since the material analyzed by MS was affinity-isolated, the scope is 'purified protein or complex'.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment uses standard data-dependent acquisition (DDA) on an Orbitrap Velos. While no explicit LFQ method is named, the use of SAINTexpress for discriminating specific from non-specific interactions in an AP-MS context typically relies on label-free intensity comparisons between IP and IgG controls.
